listing.name: Super 3-D Noah's Ark (DOS) (ReflectionHLE)
listing.summary: Play Super 3-D Noah's Ark (DOS) through ReflectionHLE with the matching original DOS game files.

steps.title: Use the matching original DOS edition
steps.instruction: Use your complete original DOS folder with NOAH3D.EXE or NOAH3DOS.EXE and matching N3D data, including AUDIOHED, AUDIOT, GAMEMAPS, MAPHEAD, VGADICT, VGAGRAPH, VGAHEAD and VSWAP. The upstream table requires exact sizes and CRCs; the SNES original is a different representation. The ReflectionHLE launcher lists the exact supported versions and required files. Select the real original folder there; its executable is original input, not the Windows player to register. Reuse a recognized installed copy without moving your originals.

steps.title: Choose a fresh managed runtime or keep your external player
steps.instruction: For a fresh Portcove-managed runtime, use Install and then explicit Play. Keep the ordinary upstream launcher: choose this entry’s exact game/version and its complete matching original-data folder there. No automatic title dispatch or original authentication by Core is promised. The managed definition passes four separate literal arguments, -datadir, ., -cfgdir, ., with the actual player's parent folder as working directory (reflectionhle.exe on Windows, reflectionhle on Linux). On Mac, the official universal app runs with the same arguments from the folder containing reflectionhle.app. Upstream creates its version-specific writable directories after accepting the originals; no setup marker or helper is fabricated. For your separate existing external player, keep the original upstream route: Extract the official Windows 64-bit ZIP and keep reflectionhle.exe, SDL3.dll and libspeexdsp-1.dll together. Select reflectionhle.exe inside its wrapper folder and use that same folder as the working directory. Leave launch arguments empty to use the game/version picker. Complete original-file selection in the upstream launcher after explicit Play. Registration does not start it; Portcove discovery runs no original EXE, helper or game.

steps.title: Preserve the shared profile and each game version
steps.instruction: Windows normally stores ReflectionHLE settings and per-version writable data beneath %APPDATA%/reflectionhle. Preserve that whole profile, your original game folders and any custom data/config/mod locations with all copies closed before changing runtimes. Several game entries share settings; version-specific writable folders remain distinct. Changing a data/config argument redirects storage and does not migrate it. Retain the working runtime for existing saves; no cross-version or cross-engine save compatibility is established.

steps.title: Keep new private progress separate from old profiles
steps.instruction: The fresh managed runtime stores ReflectionHLE configuration, controller mappings, original-location references and per-version progress in the declared paths beside the player on Windows and Linux, or beside the app bundle on Mac. It imports no AppData, DOS or existing-player saves/configuration and adopts no populated external folder. Core manages that separate runtime and its declared data through the existing install/update, retained-runtime, backup/recovery and reviewed removal contracts. Keep originals and every external profile outside it unchanged. Existing user-selected registrations retain their creating runtime and old external ownership; they are not converted by this offer. Runtime rollback does not certify save compatibility. Preserve the creating runtime and actual progress before older-version use. Customized original/data/config argument overrides require separate upstream/external handling.

warnings: The ordinary upstream launcher still requires explicit matching game/version/original-folder selection. Fixed -gamever skips that picker and is not used.

This new installation does not import existing saves from external copies or the original DOS game. Save compatibility has not been confirmed. Keep those saves and the game versions that created them separately.
Matching original game files are required to play and are not included. Existing saves are not imported, and compatibility with saves from other versions has not been confirmed.

references.title: Set up Android with the upstream app
references.instruction: Use the official Android APK from the upstream releases. In its launcher, select this entry’s exact game version and complete matching original folder. The app may ask for broad storage access to browse shared folders. Keep your originals separately and back up the app’s appdata folder, where accessible, before replacing the app. Android installation and updates are handled by you and the upstream app.

presentation.manual_preparation: In ReflectionHLE, choose a supported game edition and the folder containing its matching original files. Keep originals in their existing location. New saves, configuration and original-location references stay private to this managed runtime. Existing DOS, AppData and other-player profiles remain separate; they are not imported or converted. Preserve the creating runtime with existing progress before older-version use. Runtime rollback does not establish save compatibility.
